title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning for 1 Second?
summary: At the equator, Earth spins at 1,670 km/h (465 m/s). If it stopped for 1 second, inertia would launch everything sideways at supersonic speed, oceans would form monstrous global tidal waves, and the geodynamo magnetic field would shudder.
